name: Fiorano Open 2018
information: * You need to pay in advance the registration fee in order to complete your registration. No registrations will be accepted without payouts. * Remember to check you email address for confirmation message which will be likely sent 1-2 weeks before the competition. * **If you can't participate anymore you can ask for a refund until the 18th March 2018**. After that date no more refunds will be given.
